goal: an untouched final evaluation set for push_T (episode-disjoint from the 100 episodes used by R2-R9), frozen BEFORE any model is evaluated on it

extends.note: metrics/baselines/gates are inherited unchanged; only the acquisition, freeze and disjointness rules are extended

must_be_content_disjoint_from.rule: no file name overlap AND no content_sha256 overlap with any of the 100 used episodes

splits.rule: episode-level disjoint; DEV chosen by seeded hash of the content_sha256; FINAL is the remainder

metrics_primary: physical L1 over 14 joint dims (frame mean, then episode macro)

acquisition_routes.requires_authorization: data download by the research lead
acquisition_routes.precheck: content hash must not collide with the used 100 (tools/r8_eval_manifest.py disjoint)

acquisition_routes.requires_authorization: simulation collection by the research lead
acquisition_routes.precheck: same task/robot/3 cameras, 25 Hz, record in a NEW directory, never overwrite existing data

acquisition_routes.requires_authorization: not authorizable as a push_T final set
acquisition_routes.precheck: rejected: demo/stack_bowls/sweep_blocks are different tasks (see r9_data_sources.json)

freeze_procedure: g1 build: tools/r8_eval_manifest.py build --data-dir <new dir> --task-filter push --out manifest.json
g2 verify: tools/r8_eval_manifest.py verify --manifest manifest.json  (must be ok)
g3 disjoint: tools/r8_eval_manifest.py disjoint --manifest manifest.json --split data/split80.json (must be ok)
g5 freeze: tools/r8_eval_manifest.py freeze --manifest manifest.json --protocol protocol/r9_eval_protocol.json --git-sha <SHA> --out frozen_manifest.json
g6 commit the frozen manifest and its sha256 BEFORE any model touches the set; any later change invalidates the evaluation

gates.g1_build: manifest built from the new directory
gates.g2_verify: manifest verifies against the directory (content hashes stable)
gates.g3_disjoint: no name/content overlap with the used 100, no duplicate content inside
gates.g5_freeze: frozen manifest committed with protocol sha + git sha
gates.g6_no_peek: no model evaluation on FINAL before g5

forbidden: downloading or recording data without research-lead authorization
evaluating FINAL before the freeze is committed
reusing any of the 100 used episodes (or their frames) as FINAL
presenting cross-task data as a push_T final set
overwriting existing HDF5 files or previous evidence
evidence_requirements: manifest + verify + disjoint JSON for every candidate directory
frozen manifest sha256 and the git SHA that committed it
